name: ListingBuyerPrice
description: The buyer-facing price for a listing, including VAT, inclusive shipping (UK), and active promotions.

base_price.description: The pre-discount listing price with VAT applied, excluding shipping. When a promotion is active, this is the price before the discount is applied.

shipping_cost.description: The shipping cost to the buyer's country. Includes VAT where applicable. Null when shipping is free or unavailable — use is_free_shipping to distinguish.

is_free_shipping.description: Whether shipping is free to the buyer's country.

original_price.description: The display price. For UK buyers, includes base + shipping (DMCC). For others, base price only.

discounted_price.description: The sale price. For UK buyers, includes base + shipping. For others, base price only. Null if no active promotion.

discount_amount.description: The discount amount as money (original_price - discounted_price). Null if no active promotion.

discount_percentage.description: The discount percentage (e.g. 20 for 20% off). Null if no active promotion or if the promotion is a fixed-amount discount.

has_discount.description: Whether an active promotion applies to this listing.

discount_start_epoch.description: The start timestamp of the active promotion. Null if no active promotion.

discount_end_epoch.description: The end timestamp of the active promotion. Null if no active promotion.
